summary.title: How to do a code review
summary.one_liner: Learn Google's recommended practices for reviewing code, covering review standards, what to look for, navigating changes, review speed, comment writing, and handling pushback.
keywords: what to look for in code review
how to write code review comments
takeaways: Code review guidance is split into sections: the standard of code review, what to look for, navigating a CL, review speed, writing comments, and handling pushback.
The page presents its advice as based on long experience at Google, forming one document split into sections.
You do not need to read every section, but reading the full set is recommended for individuals and teams.
The CL Author's Guide is a companion resource for developers whose changes are under review.
summary.summary: This page is the reviewer section of Google's Engineering Practices documentation on code review. It is an index of six subpages covering the standard of code review, what to look for, navigating a CL in review, review speed, writing review comments, and handling pushback. The text states the guidance is based on long experience and that the sections together form one complete document. It also points to the CL Author's Guide for people whose changes are being reviewed.
